summary: The Guardian Halls of Stone Deep are Brell’s first sanctum, carved into the bedrock of Underfoot. Ancient stone guardians patrol labyrinthine halls, protecting the secrets of Brell’s earliest creations.
history: Formed when Brell Serilis carved the first halls beneath Norrath.
Stone guardians were animated to protect the sanctum.
Crystal veins infused the halls with divine resonance.
Collapse pressure fractured the halls into labyrinthine caverns.
The Stone Prime manifested as the embodiment of Brell’s guardianship.
